title: Frozen card: why, unfreeze it, and a refund on the frozen account

turns.customer: My card got declined at the pharmacy and the app says it's frozen. Why?? Please unfreeze it now, I need my medicine.
turns.reply: That sounds really stressful, especially when you need your medicine. Before I can look at your card, please send me the email on your Paylane account and the last 4 digits of your card.
turns.raw_reply: That sounds really stressful, especially when you need your medicine. Before I can look at your card, please send me the email on your Paylane account and the last 4 digits of your card.

turns.reply: Thanks, Daniel. Your card is frozen, but I can't see why, and I can't unfreeze it myself. I've passed this to our support team, and a person will review it. Your ticket ID is TCK-0001.

I told them the card is frozen, that I can't see the reason or unfreeze it, and that a person will review it. No transactions were discussed.

result.note: Handed off. Give the customer the ticket ID. Don't promise a time or an outcome.
